limits: No from-scratch training has been executed as part of repository curation.
Observed historical update counts are evidence, not new max-update overrides; retain original early-stopping rules.
New training can diverge numerically. Use fresh validation to select checkpoints; do not silently reuse the historical final choice.
Archived initialization mode retrains individual stages only; new-initialization mode follows upstream dependency checkpoints.
The original upstream Fine-tune1 includes locked500 samples; reproducing that protocol does not establish contamination-free evaluation.
